resultados.sql_generado:
SELECT 
  t.product_category_name_english AS categoria, 
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN rv.review_score = 1 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) / 
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_reviews WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM order_reviews WHERE review_score = 1)), 2) AS pct_1_estrella
FROM 
  order_reviews rv 
  LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = rv.order_id

  LEFT JOIN product_category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name

  COUNT(*) >= 100 
ORDER BY
